title: Safe in the Future, Dangerous in the Past: Dissecting Temporal and Linguistic Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on auditing LLM safety alignment and adversarial vulnerabilities related to temporal framing and low-resource languages (Hausa). While it evaluates 'safety' in terms of preventing harmful content (e.g., fraud or weapons manufacturing), it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific ethical/theological systems.
